question: Olivado avocado oil manufacturer company
markdown:
Olivado is the world’s leading producer of extra virgin cold-pressed avocado oil
. Founded in 2000 in Kerikeri, New Zealand, the company pioneered the cold-press extraction method for avocados, maintaining strict temperature controls under 45°C to preserve natural nutrients, vitamins, and high smoke points.

Sourcing & Operations:
Beyond New Zealand, Olivado operates a major fair-trade and organic production hub in Kenya (Olivado EPZ Ltd), partnering with thousands of small-scale farmers.
olivado.com
Sustainability:
Utilizes a circular bio-economy model where avocado waste from pressing is converted into biogas and organic fertilizer to run their facilities.
